content.title: Archer Aviation Licenses Flying-Taxi Tech For Anduril Drones
content.summary: Flying taxi startup Archer Aviation jumped 3% Tuesday, working to end a four-day slide.  The market move came after Archer agreed to supply defense tech startup Anduril Industries with electric power train technology.  A power train is the system in a vehicle that transmits energy from a motor to the wheels or blades that move the vehicle forward.
